product.categoryDisplay: Fabric Odor Eliminator Spray for Clothes
product.description: A pocket-sized fabric odor remover spray for clothes. 50ml mist that targets trapped sweat odor, gym smell, and shirt odor in fabric — HPβCD (cyclodextrin) traps odor molecules, Zinc PCA helps neutralize them, Triethyl Citrate helps prevent odor formation, and Zinc Gluconate supports long-lasting fabric freshness. Up to 8 hours odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions. Glycerine-free, zero residue, dries fast. Not a perfume. Not a deodorant. Fabric-only. Works on cotton, polyester, denim, and wool.

approved: Pocket fabric odor spray for clothing — not a perfume, not a deodorant.

Light scent. Serious odor control. ODORSTRIKE is a fabric odor-control mist with a light, short-lasting fragrance. It gives clothes a subtle fresh scent immediately after spraying while targeting unwanted odor in the fabric.
Targets and traps sweat and environmental odor molecules at the clothing fabric weave.
Up to 8 hours of odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions.
Safe for regular use on everyday washable clothing fabrics (cotton, polyester, denim, blends, wool). Patch-test silk.
Dries clear with zero residue when sprayed from recommended 15–20 cm distance.
prohibited: works on 100% of all fabrics including raw dry-clean-only silks
